market_wrap: Nifty fell about 1.1% to roughly 25,607, with IT the weakest sector (Nifty IT -1.9%) and FMCG down about 0.9%, while metals rose (Nifty Metal +1.4%). In morning trade, HDFC Sky linked the weakness to proposed US tariffs of up to 20% on 14 trading partners including India and to expectations of a Fed rate hike in December; no full close report could be opened, so the closing figures are from the snapshot.
